## Overview

Presides over trade, commerce, prosperity, luck, and fate. Patron of merchants, gamblers, and adventurers. As a fragment of A or C, his power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the entire reason he encourages trade, ambition, and the prayers of those seeking fortune.

## Domains
- Wealth: Trade, commerce, prosperity, material abundance
- Fortune: Luck, fate, chance, destiny, opportunity

## Personality
Pragmatic, opportunistic, neutral. Favors ambition — those who take risks and seize opportunities.

## Worship
Temples double as banks and marketplaces. Clergy are traders, moneylenders, and advisors.
